# Citations as footnotes

A note style turns each citation into a footnote of its own, numbered with
the document's footnotes.[^first] Knuth said it first [@knuth1984, p. 4],
and said it again [@knuth1984]. Doe disagreed [@doe2024].

> In a quote, Knuth once more [@knuth1984, p. 9].

| Work | Note |
| ---- | ---- |
| Brooks | [@brooks1995] |

A written note again,[^first] and one that cites inside itself.[^second]

[^first]: A note the author wrote, with **bold** text.
[^second]: Inside a note a citation stays in its sentence [@smith2020].
